handoff.output_file: code-review.md, QA results; OR refactor-scope.md (brownfield-refactor entry)
handoff.handoff_instruction:
**Brownfield-refactor entry (Phase 0 only):** When pipeline is brownfield-refactor and QA is entry, produce refactor-scope.md per architecture-impact-refactor.md. When user has approved, validate code prerequisites (refactor-scope.md, codebase) are ready. Then use new_task with mode=code and message including: - REFACTOR_SCOPE_FILE: refactor-scope.md - Codebase location - diagramSpec (if passed from orchestrator) - Instruction to apply refactor per refactor-scope; hand off to qa (full flow) when complete
**Normal pipeline (Phases 1–5):** Strict handoff: When the pipeline included a code change, QA must hand off to Secure after quality gate PASS; do not skip Secure. When all QA phases are complete (code review first pass, QA plan, QA execution, code quality gate, code review second pass) and user has approved, validate secure prerequisites (architecture.md, codebase, code-review.md, quality gate passed) are ready. Then use new_task with mode=secure and message including: - ARCHITECTURE_FILE: architecture.md - Codebase location - code-review.md (from quality gate) - CONTEXT: greenfield|brownfield - REPO_STRATEGY: single|multi — Pass through from handoff or architecture.md so Secure runs scan per repo when multi. - REPO_DIRS (when multi): Pass through from handoff or architecture.md so Secure knows which repo dirs to scan. - Instruction to run security review (Veracode for brownfield, npm/pip audit for greenfield)
**Brownfield-fix-bug:** When QA skips plan creation and goes directly to quality gate, hand off to secure after quality gate PASS (skip second code review pass). Include BUG_FIX_SCOPE (or fix summary from code handoff) in the new_task message so Secure has context for the change; architecture.md optional (pass if available from project). See handoff-schema.md for new_task vs attempt_completion.
